dedupe_keys.name: national mineral deposit database of china china geological survey geology in china data paper

description: A national database of mineral deposits in China published as a data paper. The Geology in China article (doi 10.12029/gc2019Z201) says the database covers 232 mineral types and 27,569 deposits in 29 provinces, compiled by the China Geological Survey from national mineral resource surveys. The article and dataset are free to read and download through the journal's data paper service. Coverage is mainland China. Caveats: the page read does not state the licence or the exact field list, and the data reflect the survey status of 2019. For simulation it shows where mineral deposits and mines are in China, the largest producer of many critical minerals, for supply concentration and hazard exposure studies. A related catalogue record is the USGS global critical minerals mines, deposits and districts dataset.
